Eldest son: “Daddy! Your posture while kneeling on the washboard isn't as handsome as mine!”
Youngest son: “Daddy! Your speed at swiping cards isn't as fast as mine!”
Huo Tingdong never expected that the biggest hindrances on his path to win back his wife would be these two little treasures!
the-ceos-rose: ***MATURE CONTENT*** Vivian is stuck in a toxic cycle. Her good for nothing boyfriend cheats again, and again, and she keeps taking him back. But one day Vivian Rose is fed up with her ex's wandering eye and decides to have some fun of her own. Enter CEO, billionaire and unapologetic playboy Ryan Terrell. A man with a hardened outer shell but a soft heart. They agree to a night of fun, but one night just isn't enough and they enter into an ‘arrangement'. Pretty soon the lines get blurred. Will they let their arrangement become more or will they let their past hurts keep them from love?
transmigration-a-farm-girls-brocade:
Having transmigrated into a little farmer girl, her father passed and her mother turned crazed. Facing a frail household, Qian Yixiu remained calm, her rise relied on strength, and also on the luck she had when being a “ghost”.
Together with her younger brother, she strived to build wealth with one hand and protect her beauty with the other...
